CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, username TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE, display_name TEXT NOT NULL, role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('teacher','student')), password_hash TEXT NOT NULL, must_change_password INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (must_change_password IN (0,1)), disabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (disabled IN (0,1)), created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS classes (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, course_code TEXT NOT NULL, term TEXT NOT NULL, total_hours INTEGER NOT NULL, current_lesson_ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS enrollments (class_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES classes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, student_no TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (class_id,user_id), UNIQUE (class_id,student_no))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS lessons (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, class_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES classes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL, week_label TEXT NOT NULL, date_label TEXT NOT NULL, title TEXT NOT NULL, detail TEXT NOT NULL, unit_range TEXT NOT NULL, hours INTEGER NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE (class_id,ordinal))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS attendance (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, class_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES classes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, lesson_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES lessons(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, student_user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('present','late','leave','absent')), note TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', recorded_by TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE (lesson_id,student_user_id))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS question_bank (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, source_lesson_ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('terminology','syntax','concept')), prompt TEXT NOT NULL, answer TEXT NOT NULL, rubric TEXT NOT NULL, source TEXT NOT NULL, active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (active IN (0,1)))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS question_records (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, class_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES classes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, lesson_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES lessons(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, student_user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, question_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES question_bank(id), score REAL NOT NULL CHECK (score >= 0 AND score <= 10), teacher_note TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', recorded_by TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), created_at TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS grades (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, class_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES classes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, student_user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, category TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (category IN ('homework','seminar','practice','final_project')), raw_score REAL NOT NULL CHECK (raw_score >= 0 AND raw_score <= 100), note TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', recorded_by TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE (class_id,student_user_id,category))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sessions (token_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY, user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, expires_at TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, last_seen_at TEXT NOT NULL, user_agent_hash TEXT NOT NULL, revoked_at TEXT)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS audit_log (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, actor_user_id TEXT REFERENCES users(id), action TEXT NOT NULL, entity_type TEXT NOT NULL, entity_id TEXT NOT NULL, summary TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS learning_attempts (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, class_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES classes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, student_user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, lesson_ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (lesson_ordinal BETWEEN 1 AND 12), module_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (module_type IN ('speaking','career','translation')), item_id TEXT NOT NULL, score REAL NOT NULL CHECK (score >= 0 AND score <= 100), response_text TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', feedback TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', created_at TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS classroom_live_events (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, class_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES classes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, lesson_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES lessons(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, event_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (event_type IN ('cold_call')), payload_json TEXT NOT NULL, created_by TEXT REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, expires_at TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cold_call_attempts (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, event_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, class_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES classes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, lesson_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES lessons(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, student_user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, question_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES question_bank(id), response_text TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', evaluation_json TEXT NOT NULL, score REAL NOT NULL CHECK (score >= 0 AND score <= 10), timed_out INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (timed_out IN (0,1)), submitted_by TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), created_at TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS classroom_barrage (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, class_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES classes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, sender_user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, content TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, expires_at TEXT NOT NULL, cleared_at TEXT, cleared_by TEXT REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS app_settings (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL, encrypted INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, updated_by TEXT, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS presentations (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, original_name TEXT NOT NULL, object_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, size INTEGER NOT NULL, version TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, slide_text_json TEXT, updated_by TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, is_current INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS assignments (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, class_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES classes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, title TEXT NOT NULL, instructions TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', due_at TEXT, attachment_name TEXT, attachment_key TEXT UNIQUE, attachment_size INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, max_score INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 100 CHECK (max_score=100), status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'published' CHECK (status IN ('published','closed')), created_by TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS assignment_submissions (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, assignment_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES assignments(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, student_user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, original_name TEXT NOT NULL, object_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, size INTEGER NOT NULL, submitted_at TEXT NOT NULL, score REAL CHECK (score IS NULL OR (score >= 0 AND score <= 100)), feedback TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', graded_by TEXT REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, graded_at TEXT, UNIQUE (assignment_id,student_user_id))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS liveavatar_leases (slot INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (slot=1), lease_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('creating','active')), expires_at BIGINT NOT NULL, heartbeat_at BIGINT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS quiz_sessions (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, payload_json TEXT NOT NULL, expires_at BIGINT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_sources (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, original_name TEXT NOT NULL, display_name TEXT NOT NULL, object_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, size INTEGER NOT NULL, content_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('ready','paused')), document_count INTEGER NOT NULL, chunk_count INTEGER NOT NULL, extracted_characters INTEGER NOT NULL, created_by TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_source_chunks (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, source_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES knowledge_sources(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, chunk_index INTEGER NOT NULL, content TEXT NOT NULL, search_text TEXT NOT NULL, citation TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(source_id,chunk_index))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS terrain_tasks (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, class_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES classes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, location_key TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (location_key IN ('grand_canyon','mount_st_helens')), title TEXT NOT NULL, instructions TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('published','closed')), created_by TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS terrain_submissions (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, task_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES terrain_tasks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, student_user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, route_json TEXT NOT NULL, rationale TEXT NOT NULL, score REAL CHECK (score IS NULL OR (score >= 0 AND score <= 100)), feedback TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', submitted_at TEXT NOT NULL, graded_at TEXT, graded_by TEXT REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, UNIQUE(task_id,student_user_id))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS users_username_lower_idx ON users(LOWER(username))
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS attendance_lesson_idx ON attendance(lesson_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS question_records_student_idx ON question_records(student_user_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS sessions_user_idx ON sessions(user_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS learning_attempts_student_idx ON learning_attempts(student_user_id,lesson_ordinal,module_type)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS classroom_live_events_active_idx ON classroom_live_events(event_type,expires_at,created_at)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS cold_call_attempts_student_idx ON cold_call_attempts(student_user_id,created_at)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS classroom_barrage_active_idx ON classroom_barrage(class_id,expires_at,created_at)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS classroom_barrage_sender_idx ON classroom_barrage(sender_user_id,created_at)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS presentations_current_idx ON presentations(is_current) WHERE is_current=1
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS assignments_class_idx ON assignments(class_id,created_at)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS assignment_submissions_assignment_idx ON assignment_submissions(assignment_id,submitted_at)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS assignment_submissions_student_idx ON assignment_submissions(student_user_id,submitted_at)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS quiz_sessions_expiry_idx ON quiz_sessions(expires_at)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_sources_status_idx ON knowledge_sources(status,updated_at)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_source_chunks_source_idx ON knowledge_source_chunks(source_id,chunk_index)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS terrain_tasks_class_idx ON terrain_tasks(class_id,status,updated_at)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS terrain_submissions_task_idx ON terrain_submissions(task_id,submitted_at)
